A 1975 Jaguar XKE with a 5.3L V12 is a passenger car with a spark-ignition engine over 3,000 cc, so it falls under heading 8703, subheading 8703.24 (cylinder capacity over 3,000 cc). The 10-digit statistical suffix for new vehicles is 8703.24.0180 ("Other: Other"). An older used car might instead fall under the used-vehicle line, but 8703.24.01 covers new and used ones alike. In HTSUS, 8703.24.01 has the subdivisions 8703.24.0130 (Electric...?) and 8703.24.0160 and 8703.24.0180, so I'm uncertain of the exact suffix. The statistical suffixes under 8703.24.01 are 8703.24.0120 (Sedans?), but CBP rulings on classic cars (e.g., a 1960s Jaguar E-type) have used 8703.24.0090 or 8703.24.0180. Weighing these, I'm going with 8703.24.0180, which is the usual "Other" line.
